responsibility: This file implements GCC’s dense simple-bitmap storage and algorithms. It provides allocation, resizing, vector allocation, equality and emptiness tests, range set/clear operations, boolean bitmap combinators, counting and dump routines, and checking-build selftests for the fixed-width bitset type declared in sbitmap.h. Its responsibility is the concrete management and manipulation of compact dense bitmaps used widely by dataflow and CFG analyses.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the non-inline implementation of the sbitmap facility—allocation/resizing, boolean and range operations, dumps, and checking selftests—whereas sbitmap.h defines the bitmap layout, inline accessors/iterators, and API declarations.
